observation: After the native merge reduces nine Areas to eight, the active query is invisible; No Matching Areas asks for another name without a search field.

Deleting the only active Area explains the requirement and offers Create Area or Cancel.
The recreated new Area retains its entered name and Blue color with explicit Create and Cancel.
The saved Area order and accessible move action agree; reorder mode retains Done and the archived-order boundary.

The empty Area archive confirmation names the Area and explains that it will be hidden from Area pickers, with Cancel and Archive.
The recreated archived Area offers Restore Area and retains its identity and saved color.
Expanded archived content reveals the same Area with its Restore action and current count.

Clear Search restores the eight remaining records, with Main showing all moved references and the original source empty.
